title: The Correlation Between Sleep Quality and Atrial Fibrillation Undergoing High-flow Nasal Cannula Oxygen (HFNC)
brief_summary: The investigators hypothesized that heated humidified high-flow nasal cannula oxygen(HFNC) along with high quality of sleep, in comparison with noninvasive positive pressure ventilation (NIV), could reduce the release of inflammatory marker C-reactive protein(CRP), which as independent predictor of atrial fibrillation（AF）, further lower the incidence of new-onset AF following coronary artery bypass grafting(CABG).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion criteria:

Hypoxemic respiratory failure

Exclusion criteria:

Cardiac or respiratory arrest
